thread:
nora: FYI Marketplace partner 'CloudFuse' wants a consolidated monthly co-bill but will send per-minute compressed batches with intermittent per-device mappings. They also flagged currency rounding drift across partners and expect an auditable lineage.

ashwin: summary of asks: 1) accept compressed archives (gz/parquet) with minute deltas, 2) support intermittent device->tenant mappings, 3) produce per-hour per-tenant rollups and a monthly co-bill CSV with provenance, 4) include round-trip checks to surface rounding drift.

marta: high-level constraints: legal/finance require ability to reproduce any billed hour from raw minutes (audit recompute), and marketplace wants a daily summary CSV. We must include provenance: source_batch_id, attribution_method, confidence_score, and pre/post-rounding fields.

ashwin: ingestion proposal: unpack compressed batch, validate schema, write raw minute rows to S3 partitioned by date/partner, then fire into kinesis topic for attribution workers. Idempotency: key = partner + batch_id. For device mapping: accept optional mapping file in same batch with mapping_ttl indicated. If mapping missing, attempt best-effort attribution and mark provenance accordingly.

ops-bot: Note: we'll need an alert if aggregated rounding delta > 0.5% over 24h for any partner; ops page created on threshold breach.

nora: rounding drift concern: some partners bill with per-device rounding to 2 decimals before summing, others sum raw units then round. That causes +/- cents differences at scale. CloudFuse wants us to offer two export modes: per-device-rounded and aggregate-rounded, and include both in CSV for reconciliation.

marta: payload example CloudFuse sent (abbreviated):
```
{
  "partner": "cloudfuse",
  "batch_id": "cf-20251012-004",
  "minutes": [
    {"minute": "2025-10-12T14:01:00Z", "tenant": "T-99", "device": "d-7", "units": 0.125},
    {"minute": "2025-10-12T14:01:00Z", "tenant": "T-99", "device": "d-8", "units": 0.375}
  ],
  "device_map": {"d-7":"T-99","d-8":"T-99"}
}
```

ashwin: attribution rules draft:
- If device_map present: attribute to tenant according to map.
- If device_map missing but tenant present on minute rows: use explicit tenant.
- If both missing: use last-known device->tenant map within last 48h; if none, mark minute as AGGREGATE and route to conservative billing (partner baseline) and open PART-8422 ticket.

nora: rounding export behavior: compute three columns in daily/hourly CSVs -> raw_sum (sum of raw units), per_device_rounded_sum (sum(round(device_minute_units,2)) aggregated), aggregate_rounded (round(sum(raw_units),2)). Include rounding_delta = per_device_rounded_sum - aggregate_rounded. Finance wants these to reconcile.

marta: storage/retention notes: keep raw minute-level for 30d for marketplace partners by default (longer than device partners), keep attributed hour rows for 13 months for invoicing. Need finance signoff on storage costs.

ashwin: late arrivals: allow 48h correction window for marketplace partners. Corrections within 48h will trigger adjustment events and updated CSVs; after 48h, create manual dispute ticket and credit adjustments on next invoice.

ops-bot: Action created PART-8422 "CloudFuse aggregate minutes w/o mapping - manual resolution" automatically when aggregate minutes > 0.

marta: test plan: replay harness must support compressed archive ingestion, device mapping missing scenarios, rounding drift simulation (generate 100k minute rows and compare both rounding export modes), and audit recompute to ensure raw->hour->monthly matches exports. Add e2e for 48h late corrections.

nora: action items:
- ashwin: PR for compressed-batch ingest + idempotency + mapping-file contract (due Thu)
- marta: CSV spec for co-bill (include both rounding modes, provenance columns) + finance sync (due Wed)
- ops-bot: add alert rule for rounding drift > 0.5% and aggregate-minute incidents (done)
- cloudfuse: provide 14 days of sample backfills and confirm mapping TTL (requested)

billing-bot: Created ticket PART-8510: "CloudFuse co-bill + rounding-drifts + mapping fallback" assigned to nora, ashwin, marta. ETA 2025-10-20

ashwin: linking draft PR https://git.redwood.internal/p/r/integrations/cloudfuse-billing if folks want to review.

marta: scheduling 30m partner sync Friday 11am UTC to lock CSV contract and rounding semantics. tagging @ashwin @nora :calendar:

nora: thanks all. we'll validate drift thresholds in the sandbox before go-live. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
